name: Search with no matches shows a helpful message
description: Typing a nonsense query into the wallet's search bar ends with a clear 'No Results Found' message and search tips, rather than a blank list or an endless spinner. Closing search returns to the wallet unchanged.
details: Typing a nonsense query into the wallet header search settles past the loading skeletons into the dedicated 'No Results Found' guidance card (with search tips) instead of a blank list or endless spinner — the no-match branch of the same search surface dm.send.nostr and send.search.npub only ever proved for successful npub resolution; closing search returns to the untouched ₿0 wallet
